text:
Lina (Eng): Hi all — noticed my July pay deducted UK PAYE even though I was on a 6-week remote contract from the UK but remained a US tax resident. Net was ~£900 less than expected :frowning:
Priya (Payroll): can you share the payslip and contract dates? Also need payroll cluster and employee id.
Lina (Eng): attached payslip_jul.pdf. dates 2024-06-10 to 2024-07-21. emp id 0087654. Location flagged as UK_CLUSTER in the system.
Priya (Payroll): system shows work_location=UK and tax_residency=US. that's causing auto PAYE. @Tom can this be corrected by payroll or do we need a treaty claim?
Tom (Tax): short visits under the US-UK double tax provisions can still trigger local withholding if payroll is run locally. Since stay <183 days and we had no UK permanent establishment for this engagement, we should reverse UK PAYE and credit US withholding where required. Steps: 1) reverse PAYE lines in UK run, 2) process off-cycle refund, 3) document treaty exception.
Avery (People Ops): employee tight on cash. fastest path?
Priya (Payroll): off-cycle refund tomorrow for net PAYE amount, flag record with TAX_FIX_UK_2024-07, then run YTD recalc. Need Tom's written note for Finance GL coding.
Payroll Bot: Off-cycle queued: offcycle-20240723-priya (ticket PAY-8077).
Lina (Eng): will I need to file anything with HMRC?
Tom (Tax): normally employer handles reporting corrections. Keep travel tickets and assignment memo in case HMRC asks. We'll prepare an employee letter.
Avery (People Ops): pls add a step to relocation checklist: confirm tax_residency vs payroll cluster before first UK payroll.
Priya (Payroll): done. created PAY-8077, refund queued GBP 950.32 -> converted to USD $1,190.45, tx TX-100332. Flagged TAX_FIX_UK_2024-07. Off-cycle posted.
Payroll Bot: Off-cycle completed: offcycle-20240723-priya  refund posted TX-100332.
Lina (Eng): refund received, thank you all! Any change to my W-2?
Tom (Tax): we'll run YTD recalculation. If US withholding changes materially we may issue a W-2c. Target timeline: refund immediate, YTD recalcs within 7 business days, W-2c decision within 10.
Avery (People Ops): closing loop: update onboarding doc and mobility checklist to verify tax flags pre-payroll run.
Priya (Payroll): will follow up with Finance for GL mapping and file internal note. Closing ticket PAY-8077.
Lina (Eng): really appreciate the quick fix :relieved:
